profile.headline: Software Engineer II at GCM Grosvenor | Northwestern B.S. Computer Engineering M.S. Computer Science
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer who enjoys building reliable, high-performance systems that make complex problems feel simple. I’ve spent the past few years working across backend development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure, mostly in C#, Python, and SQL, designing data-driven platforms that power real-time decision making.

I care about writing clean, maintainable code, collaborating across disciplines, and shipping systems that actually make a difference for users. Outside of work, I like exploring how technology can improve everyday life, from AI and automation to health and longevity. Always open to connecting with other engineers and builders who like turning ambitious ideas into working products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built a progressive web application using Flask  
• Created computer vision algorithms using Python OpenCV and made them available via a documented API   
• Programmed 3 Raspberry Pi to simulate a factory and send data to Amazon Web Services as a demonstration of IIOT
• Used AWS IOT Greengrass to communicate between the 3 Raspberry Pis
• Was asked to continue working for Marmon part-time during the 2020-2021 school year

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Worked as part of fully agile development team to enhance and maintain a digital marketing SaaS application
• Upgraded the code base and related build processes from PHP 5.6 to PHP 7.1
• Put scaffolding in place for the transition from Angular to AngularJS and converted several components
• Independently developed new software features for improved user experience and site performance
• Wrote comprehensive documentation and presented findings to development team and senior management

organizations.name: IEEE Honor Society (HKN)
organizations.description: Eta Kappa Nu is the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers International Honor society. The main goal of this organization is to foster an educational community that encourages innovation and collaboration in technology. One of the ways I did this was by participating in a mentorship program where I was paired with a freshman Engineering student and met with him throughout the quarter to answer questions about classes,  clubs, and Northwestern in general.

organizations.name: Northwestern University Robotics Club
organizations.description: The Robotics club at Northwestern is composed of several subteams that focus on different projects. One of the subteams I was on was the Underwater ROV Team. Our project was to build an underwater ROV and then enter it in a competition. The ROV had to perform a variety of tasks including grabbing material samples from inside a pipe and using computer vision to follow a path. I wrote the code for the user interface to control the ROV, and started to write the computer vision code with OpenCV prior to being sent home due to COVID-19.
